card.name: Wire-service datelines and attribution phrases
card.fires_on: Marks the end of a news dateline (the dash after a city and agency such as UPI or Reuters), and attribution words like "according to", "associated with" or "agency" in news-style text. It sits right before the report's content begins.

modes.label: News dateline
modes.description: The dash or agency name closing a city and wire-service opener at the start of a story.
modes.example: NEW YORK (Reuters Health)<< ->> There are no clear signs that eating cured

modes.label: Attribution phrases
modes.description: Words like according to, associated with, or news agency that introduce the source or a reported link.
modes.example: MTI Micro Fuel Cells' new Mobion technology solves a key hurdle in the manufacturing of fuel cells for notebook PCs and handheld devices, according<< to>> its creators.

card.plain: It lights up at the start of news stories and on phrases that credit a source or report a link.
